title: CoS-VQ: Coordinated Shared-Scale Vector Quantization for Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.37336v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) require substantial memory, motivating low-bit weight quantization for efficient deployment. Existing vector quantization (VQ) methods often improve accuracy by increasing the effective coding dimension, which can complicate independent lookup and local codeword updates. We propose CoS-VQ (Coordinated Shared-Scale Vector Quantization), which preserves low-dimensional codewords while jointly optimizing hard indices and their shared scale across positions. The key challenge is scale-induced coupling: the optimal scale depends on the entire codeword combination and, in turn, changes candidate rankings across positions, so pointwise updates can stall even after scale re-optimization. CoS-VQ collects candidates at multiple probe scales and constructs a tangent separable upper bound for the residual-aware quadratic objective. translated_title: CoS-VQ：面向大语言模型的协同共享尺度向量量化
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）需要大量内存，这促使人们采用低比特权重量化来实现高效部署。现有的向量量化（VQ）方法通常通过增加有效编码维度来提升精度，但这会使独立查找和局部码字更新变得复杂。我们提出CoS-VQ（协同共享尺度向量量化），它在保留低维码字的同时，联合优化硬索引及其在各位置间的共享尺度。关键挑战在于尺度引起的耦合：最优尺度取决于整个码字组合，而反过来又会改变各位置的候选排序，因此即使重新优化尺度，逐点更新也可能陷入停滞。CoS-VQ在多个探测尺度下收集候选，并为残差感知的二次目标构造了切线可分离上界。通过将候选比较简化为正尺度上线段的下包络问题，它……（摘要截断）
tldr: CoS-VQ在保留低维码字的前提下联合优化硬索引与跨位置共享尺度，通过多尺度候选收集与切线可分离上界克服尺度耦合难题，实现大语言模型的高精度低比特向量量化。
en_tdlr: CoS-VQ preserves low-dimensional codewords while jointly optimizing hard indices and a shared scale across positions, using multi-scale candidate collection and a tangent separable upper bound to overcome scale-induced coupling for accurate low-bit quantization of large language models.
